### `modal.dictate` — Dictation

Transcribes speech and cleans it into written text: fillers removed, punctuation added, repeats collapsed.

**Why it exists.** Speaking is three times faster than typing, but raw transcripts are not writing.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Kind | direct: computed by the engine, no model call |
| Model tier | — |
| Surface | `media` — Produces or consumes audio and images. |
| Binds to | `Mic`, `TextArea`, `Input` |
| Consent | `microphone` |
| Reads the scene | no |
| Uses registered actions | no |

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `audio` | string | no |
| `transcript` | string | no |
| `language` | string | no |

**Output**

| Field | Type |
| --- | --- |
| `text` | string |
| `source` | string |

**Use it**

```python
# attach it to a component
ui.mic("voice").ai("modal.dictate")

# or call it from a handler
result = ctx.ai("modal.dictate", {"transcript": "um so the the invoice is uh late again"})
```

**Example result** (offline Reflex engine, from the input above)

```json
{
  "text": "So the invoice is late again.",
  "source": "transcript"
}
```

### `modal.speak` — Read Aloud

Speaks any text with the speech model, falling back to the browser's built-in voice offline.

**Why it exists.** Listening is how many people prefer — or need — to consume text.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Kind | direct: computed by the engine, no model call |
| Model tier | — |
| Surface | `media` — Produces or consumes audio and images. |
| Binds to | `Text`, `Markdown`, `Insight`, `Copilot` |
| Consent | none |
| Reads the scene | no |
| Uses registered actions | no |

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | string | yes |
| `voice` | string | no |

**Output**

| Field | Type |
| --- | --- |
| `audio` | string |
| `fallback` | one of `none`, `browser` |
| `text` | string |

**Use it**

```python
# attach it to a component
ui.text("Se\u00f1or \u03a9 \u2713 \u2014 \u65e5\u672c\u8a9e \ud83d\ude80").ai("modal.speak")

# or call it from a handler
result = ctx.ai("modal.speak", {"text": "Revenue is up eighteen percent this quarter."})
```

**Example result** (offline Reflex engine, from the input above)

```json
{
  "audio": "",
  "fallback": "browser",
  "text": "Revenue is up eighteen percent this quarter."
}
```

### `modal.vision_form` — Document-to-Form

Reads a photographed receipt, card or document and fills the form fields it finds.

**Why it exists.** Retyping what a camera can already see is the purest form of busywork.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Kind | model, with an offline Reflex implementation |
| Model tier | fast |
| Surface | `fill` — Writes the resolved value (or several field values) into the form. |
| Binds to | `FileDrop`, `Form` |
| Consent | none |
| Reads the scene | no |
| Uses registered actions | no |

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `fields` | list of any | yes |
| `image` | string | no |
| `text` | string | no |

**Output**

| Field | Type |
| --- | --- |
| `fields` | list of object {name, value, confidence} |
| `notes` | string |

**Use it**

```python
# attach it to a component
ui.file_drop("receipt").ai("modal.vision_form")

# or call it from a handler
result = ctx.ai("modal.vision_form", {"fields": ["company", "amount", "date"], "text": "Tidewater Coffee Ltd\nTotal: $18.40\n2026-11-02"})
```

**Example result** (offline Reflex engine, from the input above)

```json
{
  "fields": [
    {
      "name": "company",
      "value": "Tidewater Coffee Ltd",
      "confidence": 0.8
    },
    {
      "name": "amount",
      "value": "18.4",
      "confidence": 0.95
    },
    {
      "name": "date",
      "value": "2026-11-02",
      "confidence": 0.8
    }
  ],
  "notes": null
}
```

### `modal.screenshot_scene` — Screenshot-to-Scene

Rebuilds a screenshot or mock-up as a live scene using catalogue components.

**Why it exists.** Design hand-off is a translation step; vision models can do the first draft of the translation.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Kind | model, with an offline Reflex implementation |
| Model tier | deep |
| Surface | `compose` — Renders the returned scene inside the component. |
| Binds to | `Generative`, `FileDrop` |
| Consent | none |
| Reads the scene | no |
| Uses registered actions | no |

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `image` | string | no |
| `description` | string | no |

**Output**

| Field | Type |
| --- | --- |
| `scene` | scene node |
| `rationale` | string |

**Use it**

```python
# attach it to a component
ui.generative("A compact order summary with total and status").ai("modal.screenshot_scene")

# or call it from a handler
result = ctx.ai("modal.screenshot_scene", {"description": "orders table with a search box and a New order button"})
```

**Example result** (offline Reflex engine, from the input above)

```json
{
  "scene": {
    "type": "Page",
    "id": "_r",
    "props": {
      "width": "narrow",
      "title": "Orders Table"
    },
    "children": [
      {
        "type": "Card",
        "id": "_r.0",
        "props": {
          "…": "0 keys"
        },
        "children": [
          {
            "…": "6 keys"
          }
        ],
        "on": {
          "…": "0 keys"
        },
        "ai": []
      }
    ],
    "on": {},
    "ai": []
  },
  "rationale": "Form archetype: 2 fields with types inferred from their names and a single primary action."
}
```

### `modal.describe_image` — Image Understanding

Describes what an image shows and extracts the details relevant to the task at hand.

**Why it exists.** Images uploaded to business software are data that nobody can search or summarise.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Kind | model, with an offline Reflex implementation |
| Model tier | fast |
| Surface | `annotate` — An insight panel attached to the component, with confidence and provenance. |
| Binds to | `Image`, `FileDrop` |
| Consent | none |
| Reads the scene | no |
| Uses registered actions | no |

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `image` | string | no |
| `context` | string | no |

**Output**

| Field | Type |
| --- | --- |
| `title` | string |
| `body` | string |
| `bullets` | list of string |
| `confidence` | number |
| `tone` | one of `neutral`, `success`, `warning`, `danger`, `info`, `ai` |

**Use it**

```python
# attach it to a component
ui.image("data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'/>").ai("modal.describe_image")

# or call it from a handler
result = ctx.ai("modal.describe_image", {"context": "damage claim photo"})
```

**Example result** (offline Reflex engine, from the input above)

```json
{
  "title": "Image attached",
  "body": "A description needs the vision model; connect an API key to enable it.",
  "bullets": [
    "Context: damage claim photo"
  ],
  "confidence": 0.1,
  "tone": "neutral"
}
```

### `modal.chart_digitize` — Chart Digitizer

Recovers the underlying data from a chart image so it can be re-plotted, queried or exported.

**Why it exists.** Half the world's data is trapped in screenshots of charts.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Kind | model, with an offline Reflex implementation |
| Model tier | fast |
| Surface | `service` — Invoked from application code, the CLI or the developer tools. |
| Binds to | `FileDrop`, `Image` |
| Consent | none |
| Reads the scene | no |
| Uses registered actions | no |

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `image` | string | no |
| `hint` | string | no |

**Output**

| Field | Type |
| --- | --- |
| `kind` | string |
| `points` | list of object {label, value} |
| `confidence` | number |

**Use it**

```python
# or call it from a handler
result = ctx.ai("modal.chart_digitize", {"hint": "Jan 10, Feb 14, Mar 19"})
```

**Example result** (offline Reflex engine, from the input above)

```json
{
  "kind": "bar",
  "points": [
    {
      "label": "Jan",
      "value": 10.0
    },
    {
      "label": "Feb",
      "value": 14.0
    },
    {
      "label": "Mar",
      "value": 19.0
    }
  ],
  "confidence": 0.5
}
```

### `modal.audio_actions` — Audio-to-Action-Items

Turns a meeting transcript into a recap card with decisions and owned next steps.

**Why it exists.** The value of a meeting is its follow-ups, and they are rarely written down.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Kind | model, with an offline Reflex implementation |
| Model tier | fast |
| Surface | `compose` — Renders the returned scene inside the component. |
| Binds to | `Generative`, `Mic` |
| Consent | none |
| Reads the scene | no |
| Uses registered actions | no |

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `transcript` | string | yes |

**Output**

| Field | Type |
| --- | --- |
| `scene` | scene node |
| `rationale` | string |

**Use it**

```python
# attach it to a component

# or call it from a handler
result = ctx.ai("modal.audio_actions", {"transcript": "We agreed to ship mapping first. Mira will write the guide by Friday. Dedup needs to wait."})
```

### `modal.sonify` — Data Sonification

Maps a data series to pitch so a trend can be heard: rising values rise in tone.

**Why it exists.** Charts are a visual medium; sound makes trends available to people who cannot see them.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Kind | direct: computed by the engine, no model call |
| Model tier | — |
| Surface | `media` — Produces or consumes audio and images. |
| Binds to | `Chart` |
| Consent | none |
| Reads the scene | no |
| Uses registered actions | no |

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `values` | list of number | yes |

**Output**

| Field | Type |
| --- | --- |
| `notes` | list of object {t, freq, dur} |
| `legend` | string |

**Use it**

```python
# attach it to a component
ui.chart("bar").ai("modal.sonify")

# or call it from a handler
result = ctx.ai("modal.sonify", {"values": [10, 12, 13, "… 4 more"]})
```

**Example result** (offline Reflex engine, from the input above)

```json
{
  "notes": [
    {
      "t": 0.0,
      "freq": 220.0,
      "dur": 0.2
    },
    {
      "t": 0.22,
      "freq": 246.94,
      "dur": 0.2
    },
    {
      "t": 0.44,
      "freq": 246.94,
      "dur": 0.2
    },
    "… 4 more"
  ],
  "legend": "Higher pitch means a higher value; range 10 to 40 over 1.5 seconds."
}
```

### `modal.ink` — Ink Interpretation

Recognises hand-drawn strokes as lines, rectangles, ellipses, arrows or checks for sketch-based input.

**Why it exists.** Pen and touch users think in strokes; software should meet them there.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Kind | direct: computed by the engine, no model call |
| Model tier | — |
| Surface | `service` — Invoked from application code, the CLI or the developer tools. |
| Binds to | any component, or call it from code |
| Consent | none |
| Reads the scene | no |
| Uses registered actions | no |

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `strokes` | list of list of object {x, y} | yes |

**Output**

| Field | Type |
| --- | --- |
| `shape` | one of `line`, `rectangle`, `ellipse`, `arrow`, `check`, `scribble` |
| `confidence` | number |
| `bounds` | object {x, y, w, h} |

**Use it**

```python
# or call it from a handler
result = ctx.ai("modal.ink", {"strokes": [[{"x": 0, "y": 0}, {"x": 100, "y": 0}, {"x": 100, "y": 60}, "… 2 more"]]})
```

**Example result** (offline Reflex engine, from the input above)

```json
{
  "shape": "rectangle",
  "confidence": 0.75,
  "bounds": {
    "x": 0.0,
    "y": 0.0,
    "w": 100.0,
    "h": 60.0
  }
}
```
